plan: Separate authoritative session state, action interpretation, and deterministic screen construction.
Validate each action fully before committing state changes.
Inject input/output ports and mediate them through run_once().
mechanisms: A fixed-shape session dictionary stores accepted check-in data.
Private prompt and screen builders centralize presentation rules and copy appointment choices.
Per-action validation and commit logic provides noncorrupting error handling.
Constructor-injected action_source and screen_sink support standard-library unittest fakes.
